title: Merged While Red: Post-Merge Outcomes of 2,211 Agent-Authored Pull Requests in Open Source
description: Exploratory, pre-registered technical report with code and dataset. Studies 2,211 merged pull requests authored by four coding agents (GitHub Copilot coding agent, Devin, Cursor, Jules) in 571 active open-source repositories, assigning deterministic metadata-only risk tiers and labelling 14-day post-merge reverts and referenced fixes. Not peer reviewed.
